verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a usage-billing SaaS could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, but nothing in the evidence describes AI-generated insights or suggestions. The closest items are revenue forecasting, 'spot expansion', and threshold alerts, which are standard analytics and rule-based features, not AI-generated output. An llms.txt file makes the docs readable by AI tools, but that is not an in-product AI insight capability.
